newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian inflation down to 7.6 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian inflation down to 7.6 pct in August.

text.p: Egyptian consumer prices rose 7.6 percent in the year to the end of August, down from 9.4 percent in July, an official in the cabinet office said on Sunday.
The August 1996 inflation rate also compares with 9.7 percent in the year to the end of August 1995.

The official said a seasonal factor, the presence of expatriate Egyptians from the Arabian peninsula, had made the July inflation exceptionally high. Prices rose 0.1 percent in the month to end of August, she added.
Inflation this year has ranged from a low of 6.3 percent at the end of February to the high of 9.4 percent in July.
